name: ownhow
description: Inspect, select, and improve the local AI methods you own.

interface.longDescription: OwnHow scans local Codex, Hermes, Claude Code, Pi, OpenCode, OpenClaw, and Skywork methods, explains task resolution and conflicts, records real outcomes, and evolves user-owned Personal Methods with explicit approval.
defaultPrompt: Inspect my local Codex methods and explain actionable conflicts.
Resolve my current task to the best local method.
Turn my latest correction into a Personal Method proposal.
